entries.title: A card that opens a crewmate's browser stays beside the page
entries.body: When a card's own button opens a crewmate's browser, such as Try it or View booking, the card now stays beside the page with its steps and a place to ask the crewmate a question. A new card the crewmate puts up while you look at the page appears there too, and Back to the card takes you to its choices.

picture.alt: A crewmate's browser page with the card that opened it in a column on the right: its title, its three steps, a Back to the card link and a reply field
